title: Holding the Line
blurb: The railroad's bounty is posted and the bugs are climbing. Learn the cross-cliff deal: your guns guard your partner's wall, theirs guard yours.

telegram.title: Five Nights in Dry Gulch
telegram.body: TO THE RANCHERS OF DRY GULCH STOP RAILROAD BOUNTY STANDS ON THE HIVE QUEEN AND A DEED TO THE GULCH STOP FIRST HOLD THE CLIFFS FIVE NIGHTS STOP GUARD YOUR PARTNERS WALL NOT YOUR OWN STOP THE LAW INSISTS STOP

build: Morning, ranchers. Captain Ada Stroud, airship Lucky Mandible. The railroad's paying, and the bugs are coming.
Your guns can't dip at your own wall. Thirty degrees, by law. So you cover your partner's.
Territorial Board of Firearms, 1871. A congressman shot his own boots off. Now we all suffer.
Telegram's pinned on your house board. Read it, then throw your lever.
wave: Here they come. Watch the far wall, not your feet.
held: First night held. Patch up, plant something, and keep your partner's wall clean.

build: Silas Kettle, gunsmith, aboard the ship. Bring me chitin and I'll bring you calibre.
wave: Bigger batch tonight. Mind the lanes on your partner's side.

build: Pearl Doyle, casino deck. Lose a little scrap with me sometime. I hear things worth knowing.
wave: My spyglass shows dust in every tunnel. Steady now.

build: I rode with the survey crew in '89. That tunnel didn't hit rock. It hit something hollow.
wave: One more night after this. Don't get comfortable.

build: Bad news on the wire. Something big is coming up the tunnel. They call it the Hive Wagon.
A beetle the size of a stagecoach. Aim for the soft parts. Assuming it has any.
wave: There's the Wagon. Every gun on it, ranchers!

boss_down: The Wagon's down! The railroad will want a photograph.
win: Five nights held. You've earned your keep, and a hat. Captain's orders.
lost: We lost a house. Regroup. We'll fly it again from the top.

journal.title: Specimen Notes, No. 1
journal.body:
The Hive Wagon's plating is grown, not shed. It wears its armour like a coat. Something down here does the tailoring.

I have asked the Captain to stop calling me 'the Mole'. She has not stopped.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: Ranchers Hold Dry Gulch; Hive Wagon Derailed
